text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Zephyr-san. I look forward 
to another year of your majestic, 
awe-inspiring presence.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whew~~!! Imposing and majestic!! Feeling 
fantastic!! We've gotta hype up Zephyr's 
birthday to the max~☆

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
My, what a beautiful seasonal breeze... 
Thank you very much, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yesss!! Let's keep riding this great wave 
straight into the birthday fest 
afterwards~☆

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I am looking forward to it... 
Helios-san prepared everything like a 
whirlwind, from setting up the venue to 
sending out the invitations.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup! We put crazy effort into the 
setlist, ya know?! Starting with a duet 
between me and Palm-chin, and then a 
massive birthday sing-along hyped up to 
the 100th power!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
And then for the climax, there's even the 
debut of the "Hayate Birthday Anthem: 
Besties 4Ever SP"...!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...? I'm sorry, what was that just now?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Hayate Birthday Anthem: Besties Forever 
Special"! Music and lyrics by me! Vocals 
and dance by Zephyr!! —Ah, phone call!! 
Sorry!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so the wire action really is a go!? 
Awesome~☆ Now we can pull off the stage 
effect where Zephyr rides the wind while 
shining brilliantly!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how embarrassing... Still, I've 
trained rigorously just for today.
